scope: Decision coverage of every repository in the latest 357-star snapshot (2026-09-24 authenticated refresh, all public); the earlier 342-star and 337-star reviews remain dated baselines. This is not a claim of exhaustive ecosystem discovery, full code/security audit, installation, performance superiority or profitable trading.

method.discovery: Latest discovery (2026-09-24) uses the authenticated user/starred endpoint with the star+json media type, recorded in latest_public_refresh: 357 repositories, 15 additions since the 342-row public snapshot and no removals. All 357 are public: the 342 earlier identities came from the public endpoint and a GraphQL check confirmed the 15 additions are public. The 342-row snapshot (2026-09-20) used the paginated public users/seathatflowsinourveins/starred endpoint and added five repositories to the 337-row baseline.
method.baseline_discovery: Earlier 2026-09-19 337-star audit: native GitHub CLI paginated authenticated starred endpoint with star+json media type; private flag checked before inclusion. That repository set matched its prior snapshot.
method.source_capture: For each previously unassessed public repository, resolve default-branch HEAD, then request README and license at that commit. One oversized README used a successful raw-media fallback. Full captures remain private; only typed conclusions and public source links are published. The 2026-09-24 refresh resolved default-branch HEAD for each addition and for six re-reviewed targeted candidates, then read the files listed per entry at that commit; release and package-index metadata were checked where an entry says so.
method.review: Individually authored dispositions after primary README purpose/heading and license-declaration inspection. Selected candidates received additional documentation/API/source-section inspection. Mechanical excerpt selection was used to bound reading; no keyword score made the decisions. The 2026-09-24 reviews also record a wiring verdict (wire_now, wire_after_acceptance, reference_only or do_not_wire) and any proposed acceptance case in each entry's limitations.
method.depth_boundary: readme_license_overview is a narrow source screen, not a deep review. selected_primary_files means only the enumerated sections were inspected; it does not certify the whole repository. prior_evidence_link retains earlier scope without re-review.
method.private_handling: Only public repositories are included. No credentials, private account data, star-user timeline, private repository names, raw source cache or native session identifiers are published; the public GitHub username identifies the discovery endpoint. The 2026-09-24 authenticated listing contained no private repository; per-repository star timestamps are not published.
method.runtime_boundary: No new runtime/model/broker work in this audit. Existing native evidence remains in linked typed receipts. The 2026-09-24 refresh cloned, installed and executed nothing; proposed acceptance cases are unexecuted.
method.source_pin_scope: Default-branch source snapshots are not necessarily published releases or installed versions. Null source_date on prior evidence means no fresh commit-date lookup.
